svg.title: Pump types – sections of external gear, vane and axial piston pumps (example)
svg.text: Pump types – simplified sections: external gear · vane (variable) · axial piston (swash plate, variable)
All three are displacement pumps: Q = V · n · η_v / 1000. The pump makes flow; the load makes pressure; the relief / compensator limits it.
Oil is carried in the tooth gaps around the OUTSIDE.
Side plates (bushings) are pressed on the gears by outlet
pressure → η_v 0.90–0.95 new; wear lowers it.
e = eccentricity → V. At the set pressure the oil force
pushes the ring against the spring: e → 0, Q → 0.
V = z · A_k · D · tan α. Swash angle α → 0: no flow.
Pistons + slippers slide on the plate; 2 kidneys: S, P.
28–35 MPa, η_t 0.88–0.92 → best for high pressure.
Data = typical ranges of guide 29 §4.1–4.6 (vane η_t from η_v · η_hm). Example job of guide 25: 14 cm³/rev gear pump, 1450 rpm → 18.7 L/min.
Makers (examples, §17.1 of this guide): gear – Rexroth AZPF, Casappa, Marzocchi, Parker PGP · internal gear – Rexroth PGF / PGH, Eckerle, Voith IPV
vane – Danfoss (Vickers) V / VQ, Parker (Denison) T6 / T7 · axial piston – Rexroth A10VSO, Parker PV, Danfoss PVH
